headline: UOB plans to hire 1,000 graduates a year and train 5,500 managers on AI
body: UOB expects to recruit 1,000 young graduates a year. Its Better Leader Programme aims to reach 5,500 managers across the region by the end of 2027, and managers practise workplace conversations on an AI-enabled coaching and role-play platform.
note: UOB pairs graduate hiring with AI-based coaching for its managers, which suggests banks are treating the people side of AI adoption as part of the plan.

evidence.text: The bank plans to hire 1,000 young graduates a year, train 5,500 managers using an AI coaching platform, and open customer-facing and sales advisory roles to experienced professionals seeking flexible work.
As concerns grow over AI’s impact on entry-level jobs, UOB expects to recruit 1,000 young graduates a year.
UOB’s new Better Leader Programme, accredited by the Institute of Banking and Finance (IBF), aims to reach 5,500 managers across the region by the end of 2027.
Managers will practise workplace conversations on an AI-enabled coaching and role-play platform customised to UOB’s leadership competencies.
